name: Seven Craft Apps: Official GitHub Links
description_md:
Find the official repositories for the seven Craft apps mentioned in the reel.

- Direct GitHub links for image, video, motion, vector, photo, PDF and layout work.

- A small first-test plan and a prompt for your AI assistant.

- Clear notes on untested compatibility and installation.

Plain-text link pack. Free download. These early projects have not been tested as replacements for your current apps.
